movelist.name: Noble Roar
movelist.effect: Noble Roar lowers all targets’ Attack and Special Attack by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Iron Defense
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Work Up
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Overcoat
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Moves with the Powder Keyword, and does not take damage from any Weather that would normally cause it to take damage. Defensive.

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.effect: The user resists all X target ranged attacks one step further. This refers to attacks and Moves that simply hit one target or specify hitting multiple targets, such as Razor Wind hitting three targets. It has no effect on Moves that are capable of hitting multiple targets through areas of effect, such as Bursts or Cones. Defensive.

abilities.name: Discipline
abilities.effect: If the user gains initiative and is Confused, Enraged, Infatuated, or Flinched, they may activate Discipline to cure themselves of any of these conditions.
